$comment: Release-blocking security gates fail on every CRITICAL/HIGH finding that has a
published fix. An entry here is the ONLY way to let one through, and adding one is
a deliberate, reviewed act — the boundary is recorded, never waived silently.
Same idiom as scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs's FROZEN_ADVISORIES and the a11y scan's
ACCEPTED_SERIOUS_RULES, with one addition this file enforces that those do not:
every entry carries an `expires` date, and scripts/security-allowlist-gate.mjs
FAILS THE BUILD once that date passes — whether or not the finding still appears.
An exception nobody re-examines is not an exception, it is a hole.
Required fields per entry: id, scope, package, owner, justification, expires.
scope: one of the scan scopes below (container:backend, container:frontend).
owner: the human accountable for revisiting it, not a team alias.
expires: YYYY-MM-DD, UTC. Keep it short — 90 days is the intended maximum.
